measurements.name: dispersion Pearson r of PDE mode growth versus analytic sigma
measurements.method: Pearson r of σ_PDE(k) vs σ_analytic(k) for k in [0.11, 0.52] µm^-1
measurements.reference_source: pass-2 gate threshold; not the measured r
measurements.note: goodness-of-fit of the Fourier solver to the Turing dispersion relation

measurements.name: dispersion RMSE of PDE mode growth
measurements.method: RMSE of σ_PDE − σ_analytic on the same wavenumber window

measurements.name: wavelength-sweep Pearson r
measurements.method: Pearson r of PDE dominant wavelength vs 24*sqrt(s) across diffusivity scales s
measurements.note: nonlinear ratio mean 1.2500; saturated spots run longer than k_c

measurements.name: wavelength-sweep RMSE
measurements.method: RMSE between saturated PDE wavelength and the linear λ_c(s)
measurements.note: the bias is the nonlinear shift, reported rather than fitted away

measurements.name: nonlinear stripe wavelength on the 192 µm patch
measurements.method: dominant Fourier wavelength of the saturated activator on the 192×144 µm patch
measurements.note: value is the saturated mode, reference is the linear prediction

measurements.name: equal-diffusion ablation peak growth rate
measurements.note: negative control; patterned margin at Dv/Du = 18 is positive

measurements.name: specimen red-lobe foreground fraction
measurements.method: Otsu threshold on redness R−0.5(G+B) of the CC BY-SA trap photograph
measurements.reference_source: same Otsu procedure on the pass-2 GIF last frame
measurements.note: photograph versus render; the two fractions are measured separately

measurements.name: specimen image structure-tensor coherency
measurements.method: mean (λ1−λ2)/(λ1+λ2) of the Sobel structure tensor inside the lobe mask
measurements.reference_source: same coherency on the pass-2 GIF last frame

measurements.name: specimen lobe circularity
measurements.method: 4π area / perimeter² of the Otsu redness mask
measurements.reference_source: same circularity on the rendered last frame
measurements.note: cilia make the mask far from a circle

measurements.name: specimen red-channel KS distance versus rendered lobe
measurements.method: two-sample KS statistic of redness inside the specimen mask vs the render mask
measurements.note: KS distance is not zero; distributions were not copied

measurements.name: predecessor subcellular domain patterns
measurements.note: 8 µm domain is below one wavelength and outside the Turing band

measurements.name: successor tissue wavelength count
measurements.reference_source: wavelength count on the 192 µm patch modelled here
measurements.note: same k_c, different mode count; Holocene age 0 Ma, chronoseries 1/1
